info.title: Waddani Mobile Auth API
info.description: Member-facing auth endpoints for the mobile app. Kept separate from the staff-facing /auth/* endpoints -- member and staff tokens are never interchangeable (see requireMemberAuth vs requireAuth).

body.description: Rich text (HTML), written via the admin portal's WYSIWYG editor.

imageUrl.description: Featured image URL, uploaded via POST /uploads.

Notification.description: NEWS/EVENT are broadcasts to every app member (since they joined); PAYMENT/DONATION are personal. Open entityId with the matching endpoint (e.g. GET /mobile/news/{id}).

entityId.description: The news article / event / payment / donation id.

Event.description: Staff-managed, read-only for mobile. Scoped to the fixed "Online" organization every mobile member belongs to.

Donation.description: A single, campaign-less donation -- no goal/progress tracking. Membership is not required: a member donation carries memberId, a guest donation carries donorName/donorPhone instead.

donorName.description: Guest donor name -- null when memberId is set.

donorPhone.description: Guest donor phone -- null when memberId is set.

method.description: CARD donations are recorded by POST /mobile/payments/card/confirm once the hosted checkout is verified.

MembershipCard.description: Issued automatically during registration (see registerAndPayMobileMember) -- never created or edited by the member directly.

cardCode.description: Human-readable card code printed under the QR, e.g. "MC-2026-AB12CD"

verifyUrl.description: The value to encode in the card's QR: a link to the public verify page, which any phone camera can open. Absent when the server has no VERIFY_BASE_URL configured -- encode cardCode instead.

membershipTypeIconUrl.description: Public URL of the icon for the member's membership type, ready to load directly. null when that plan has no icon. Read live rather than stored on the card, so re-uploading a plan's icon changes it here immediately -- unlike membershipType and membershipTypeStars, which are fixed at issuance.

FieldErrors.description: Per-field messages keyed by request field name -- show the first message under that input. Returned as error.details on a 400/409 from /mobile/auth/register.

email: A member with this email already exists

get.description: Public, no auth -- populates the plan selector during registration, before a member has an account. Only plans marked isPublic are returned. "Plans" is the mobile-facing name for the staff-facing MembershipType catalog. A plan is either fixed-price (priceMax null) or priced as a range the member picks an amount within, e.g. Gold at $5-$50 (price "5.00", priceMax "50.00"). iconUrl is a ready-to-load image URL, or null when no icon was uploaded for that plan.

price.description: Decimal string, e.g. "5.00". The fixed price when priceMax is null, otherwise the lowest amount the plan accepts.

priceMax.description: Decimal string, e.g. "50.00" -- the highest amount the plan accepts. null means the plan is fixed-price at price.

iconUrl.description: Public URL of the plan's icon image, ready to load directly. null when staff uploaded no icon for this plan -- render your own placeholder in that case.

get.summary: Unread notification count (for the bell badge)

post.summary: Self-register a mobile member and pay via Sifalo Pay (Waafi, eDahab or Premier Wallet)
post.description: No ID document / signed-terms upload -- only a photo is required. Attaches the new member to the fixed "Online" organization. Sets termsAcceptedAt to the current time (click-through acceptance, not a document). Registration is atomic with payment: amount and method are client-supplied (amount is trusted as-is, not cross-checked against the plan's price) and charged via WAAFI mobile money against payerPhone (separate from the registrant's own phone). If the charge fails the member is rolled back (soft-deleted) -- there is no half-registered, unpaid state. Free plans (price "0.00" with priceMax null) skip payment entirely: omit amount, method and payerPhone (any sent are ignored), and the member is created at once with a $0.00 FREE payment and a membership card -- the same 201 response as a paid wallet registration.

email.description: Optional. Omit, or send an empty string or null, to register without an email.

membershipPeriodId.description: Optional. Omit to get the default 12-month period. Usually left out in favour of membershipMonths.

membershipMonths.description: Optional. How many months the membership lasts, typed in by the member: minimum 1 month, maximum 60 (5 years). Sets expiry (payment date + months) and each renewal. Omit for the default 12 months.

payerPhone.description: Required for wallet methods: the wallet (per `method`) to charge the plan fee to -- may differ from `phone` (e.g. a family member paying on the registrant's behalf). Not used for CARD.

returnUrl.description: Optional override for where Sifalo sends the customer after the hosted checkout. Defaults to the server CARD_RETURN_URL -- the bundled verification page, which confirms the payment and shows the outcome. Sifalo appends sid; the API appends checkout_id.

amount.description: Decimal string, e.g. "24.00". Trusted as sent -- not validated against the plan's price, nor kept between price and priceMax for a range-priced plan, so the app is responsible for only sending an amount the range it showed allows.

method.description: Required (with amount) unless the chosen plan is free. Processed through Sifalo Pay. WAAFI covers ZAAD, EVC, eSAHAL, CASHPLUS and JEEB and is charged directly. CARD (Visa/Mastercard) uses hosted checkout: the member is only created after POST /mobile/payments/card/confirm verifies the payment.

201.description: Member created, payment completed, and membership card issued

202.description: method CARD: nothing has been created yet. Send the customer to checkoutUrl; when they return, call POST /mobile/payments/card/confirm with checkoutId and the sid Sifalo appended to returnUrl.

400.description: Invalid payload (error.details holds per-field messages) or unknown membershipTypeId/membershipPeriodId

409.description: A member with this phone or email already exists (phone and email are unique among active members; email is case-insensitive). For CARD this is checked before the checkout starts; for wallets the charge is not attempted. error.details names the field so the app can show the message under it.

error.message: A member with this email already exists

email: A member with this email already exists

422.description: Sifalo Pay declined the charge (insufficient balance, wrong PIN, cancelled, etc.) -- the member was not created

503.description: Sifalo Pay gateway is not configured or unreachable -- the member was not created

post.summary: Check whether an email is already registered
post.description: Call on blur of the email field. If exists is true, show "A member with this email already exists" under the field instead of waiting for the full registration to fail. Case-insensitive.

200.description: true = already used by another member; false = free to register

post.description: When mustChangePassword is true the member logged in with a temporary password set by staff: the app must send them straight to a "choose a new password" screen and call POST /mobile/auth/password/change before anything else.

mustChangePassword.description: True after logging in with a staff-set temporary password

post.description: Stateless JWT -- this just validates the token; the client is responsible for discarding it.

get.summary: Get the caller's own member id/org (from the token)

post.description: Sends a 6-digit OTP via WhatsApp (to the member's WhatsApp number, or phone if none) and via Amazon SES email when the account has an email; it is valid for 10 minutes and only the latest one works. Phones are matched exactly (send the +252 international form); emails case-insensitively.

200.description: Code sent to the WhatsApp and/or email on the account

404.description: No member matches the phone or email (details.code ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND)

422.description: No channel can reach the member -- no email on file and WhatsApp is not configured (details.code NO_EMAIL_ON_FILE)

post.summary: Reset password with the OTP sent by WhatsApp or email
post.description: The OTP is single-use and expires 10 minutes after issuance.

identifier.description: Same phone/email used for the forgot request

post.description: Required right after a login that returned mustChangePassword: true (staff-set temporary password); clears that flag. Also usable any time to change the password.

currentPassword.description: The temporary password, or the current one

400.description: Invalid payload, or current password is incorrect (details.code WRONG_CURRENT_PASSWORD)

get.summary: Get the caller's own membership card
get.description: View only -- always scoped to the authenticated member, never a URL param, so a member can never read anyone else's card. Returns membershipCard: null if none has been issued yet (should not normally happen, since registration always issues one).

get.summary: Get the caller's own payment history
get.description: View only -- always scoped to the authenticated member, never a URL param.

post.description: No account, no token, no membership -- a guest gives fullName and phone with the payment and nothing else is stored. A signed-in member should use POST /mobile/members/me/donations instead, which attributes the donation to their member record; this endpoint always records a guest donation, even if the phone matches an existing member. Payment rules are identical to the member endpoint: amount is trusted as sent, payerPhone is required for wallet methods (and may differ from the donor phone), CARD goes through the hosted checkout.

fullName.description: The donor's name, stored on the donation as donorName.

phone.description: The donor's phone, stored on the donation as donorPhone.

payerPhone.description: Wallet to charge. Required for wallet methods; not used for CARD.

returnUrl.description: Optional override for where Sifalo sends the customer after the hosted checkout. Defaults to the server CARD_RETURN_URL.

amount.description: Decimal string, e.g. "10.00". Trusted as sent.

202.description: method CARD: nothing has been donated yet. Send the customer to checkoutUrl; when they return, call POST /mobile/payments/card/confirm with checkoutId and the sid Sifalo appended to returnUrl. The donor name/phone are replayed onto the donation once the card is verified.

503.description: Sifalo Pay gateway is not configured or unreachable

get.summary: Get the caller's own donation history
get.description: View only -- always scoped to the authenticated member, never a URL param.

post.description: No campaign, no eligibility check -- any authenticated member can donate any amount at any time. Donating without a membership is POST /mobile/donations. Same trust rules as registration/renewal: amount is client-supplied and trusted as sent, method must be one of WAAFI, EDAHAB or PREMIER_WALLET, payerPhone may differ from the member's own phone.

payerPhone.description: Required for wallet methods; not used for CARD.

returnUrl.description: Optional override for where Sifalo sends the customer after the hosted checkout. Defaults to the server CARD_RETURN_URL -- the bundled verification page, which confirms the payment and shows the outcome. Sifalo appends sid; the API appends checkout_id.

amount.description: Decimal string, e.g. "10.00". Trusted as sent.

202.description: method CARD: nothing has been donated yet. Send the customer to checkoutUrl; when they return, call POST /mobile/payments/card/confirm with checkoutId and the sid Sifalo appended to returnUrl.

503.description: Sifalo Pay gateway is not configured or unreachable

post.description: Only reachable once the current membership period has actually expired -- an early renewal attempt is rejected with 409 (the same eligibility check the staff payment endpoints use). amount/method/payerPhone follow the same rules as registration: amount is trusted as sent, method must be one of WAAFI, EDAHAB or PREMIER_WALLET, payerPhone may differ from the member's own phone. On success, extends the existing card's validUntil rather than issuing a new one.

payerPhone.description: Required for wallet methods; not used for CARD.

returnUrl.description: Optional override for where Sifalo sends the customer after the hosted checkout. Defaults to the server CARD_RETURN_URL -- the bundled verification page, which confirms the payment and shows the outcome. Sifalo appends sid; the API appends checkout_id.

amount.description: Decimal string, e.g. "24.00". Trusted as sent -- not validated against the price of the plan being renewed, nor kept between its price and priceMax when that plan is range-priced.

409.description: Not eligible yet -- the member's current membership period is still active

503.description: Sifalo Pay gateway is not configured or unreachable

get.description: Used by the verification page to show what is being paid while it confirms, and to tell an already-completed checkout from a dead link. No auth: the id is an unguessable uuid and nothing identifying is returned -- no member, payload or result.

post.summary: Confirm a card payment and complete the registration, renewal or donation
post.description: Step 2 of a CARD payment (step 1 is register / renew / donate with method CARD). Call it when the customer returns from Sifalo hosted checkout, with the checkout_id and sid from the return URL. The API verifies the sid with Sifalo (status success, code 601). The paid amount is not compared to the checkout: Sifalo deducts fees from card payments, so it reports a lower net amount, then creates the member / records the payment or donation exactly as the wallet flow would. No auth: a card registration has no member yet, and a guest donation never has one, so the checkout id plus a Sifalo-verified sid is the proof. Safe to repeat: a completed checkout returns its stored result, and a sid completes only one checkout.

200.description: Completed. Body carries purpose (REGISTER | RENEW | DONATE) plus that flow's normal result: member + payment + membershipCard, payment + membershipCard, or donation.

409.description: Checkout already used or in progress, or the request can no longer be completed (e.g. phone registered meanwhile -- the payment then needs a manual refund)

422.description: Payment not completed (still pending or failed at Sifalo)

503.description: Sifalo Pay gateway is not configured or unreachable
